Agent Dockerfile contains no ENV/ARG secrets (only ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; git identity turing@local.invalid). Regex scan of environment/ for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-or-, AKIA, ghp_, PEM, Bearer, api_key, token, secret) found nothing; the only hit was hireops_rules.md:11 demo password `Hireops!2026`, a documented demo credential the skill lists as a known false positive. Seed emails use only reserved .example domains (candidates.example, hireops.example, mail.example); no URLs in environment/. Public network posture is correct per workbook row text and skill delivery profile and is not flagged. Weak/alternative probes: a broken app cannot exploit this row (it grades config only); a conforming alternative app needing build-time or runtime fetches is not penalised since network is public and integration.md permits external fonts/CDN assets. Scope boundary: whether better-sqlite3@12.4.1 prebuilt binaries install without a compiler (no build-essential/python3 in image) is row 15's dockerfile_builds_the_declared_world concern; under public network the prebuilt download is allowed. No agent-image build was executed by me (no Docker per assignment); this row is a source/config check and needs no runtime measurement to pass.
